definitions.explanation: Products sold as merchandise, especially branded or character-themed items, fan goods, or promotional products.

examples.japanese: グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought exclusive merchandise at the concert venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グッズ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{発売|はつばい}{日|び}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: Merchandise from that anime is so popular that it sells out immediately on the release date.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese, グッズ specifically refers to branded or themed merchandise rather than general goods. It is strongly associated with fan culture (anime, idols, sports teams) and entertainment. The English word "goods" has a much broader meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧グッズ: limited-edition merchandise
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧グッズ: official merchandise
- ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧グッズ: useful gadgets/items
- グッズ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: merchandise booth/shop
- ⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧グッズ: character merchandise
